Enter the URL of the Indiatimes feeds. (http://info.indiatimes.com/rss/toi.opml).
If you want to add the feeds manually Click on "New Feed" in the "Feed Subscriptions" panel.

Copy the URL of the feed from this page (example: https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/rssfeeds/13352306.cms)
Click "Ok" and you are ready to roll!
